subject: SLA claim: regional availability lapse — evidence bundle & proposed credit split
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novacart.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novacart.com
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -0400
Subject: Production availability gap during peak — request for SLO adjudication

Hi Sean —

We saw a significant availability drop in your hosted inference endpoint (api.redwood.ai) for our checkout flow during our US peak window this morning: roughly 09:12–09:26 PDT. Customer-facing errors spiked (429/503) and our checkout success rate dropped ~7% for that interval. We've logged the impact to our SRE and procurement teams and are initiating an SLA claim per section 4.2 of our contract.

Can you confirm whether this window is eligible for credit? We need:
- a confirmation of the exact downtime/availability window you observe on your side
- a telemetry bundle (traces, token-level acceptance rates, region routing logs) that maps to our traffic
- a preliminary estimate of credit eligibility or next steps

Attaching our completed claim form (novacart-sla-claim-form.pdf). Please treat this as high priority — this impacted several enterprise transactions this morning.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform Reliability, Novacart
Marta.ruiz@novacart.com

Attachments: novacart-sla-claim-form.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novacart.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 16:29:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Production availability gap during peak — request for SLO adjudication

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the quick heads up and for attaching the claim form. I'm escalating this to our SRE and SLA ops leads (cc'ed). Initial acknowledgement: we see elevated 503 rates in us-west-2 during the interval you provided; we will pull a telemetry bundle and share a timestamp-aligned trace set within 2 business hours.

Immediate asks from our side so we can correlate traffic reliably:
- can you share the sample transaction ids or request IDs for two representative failed checkouts? (if you can redacted IDs are fine)
- did you observe any client-side retries that expanded the total request count?

We'll also include a preliminary proportional credit calculation (per contract section 4.2.1) and a proposal for split credits if the impact was mixed (edge vs control-plane).

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Escalations — Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Attachments: none
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 17:02:00 -0400
Subject: internal: pulling traces & preliminary window

Sean / Kimberly —

I've kicked off a trace pull for the us-west-2 cluster and created a telemetry snapshot (rdw-telemetry-snapshot-2028-06-29.zip). Early look: the control-plane had a degraded control loop caused by a noisy autoscaler evaluation that overlapped with a small model promotion; this produced elevated 429/503 signals at the LB layer for ~12–14 minutes starting ~09:11 PDT.

Notes for adjudication:
- autoscaler/decision logs attached in the bundle (control-plane-eval.log)
- model-serving hot-swap occurred at 09:09:45 PDT; KV cache warmup lag evident until ~09:24 PDT
- prefix caching reduced token cost but introduced a short KV cache miss spike when the promotion hit high QPS

I'll assemble a proposed credit math and a breakdown of how much of the impact maps to edge routing vs platform control-plane. If we recommend partial credit, propose split: 70% platform responsibility / 30% operational overlap due to model promotion.

Karthik
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rdw-telemetry-snapshot-2028-06-29.zip
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novacart.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 18:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Production availability gap during peak — request for SLO adjudication

Marta —

Thanks for filing. I've attached a cleaned subset of traces aligned to the two transaction ids Marta provided in her reply (see attached excerpt). High-level summary for your procurement and SRE teams:
- Verified outage window (platform-observed): 2028-06-29T09:11:20Z -> 2028-06-29T09:24:35Z (US/PDT)
- Measured customer-visible error uplift (sampled): 6.8% increase in non-2xx responses against baseline for that 13m window
- Root cause: autoscaler evaluation collision with a model promotion causing transient stateful-worker unavailability and KV cache cold misses

Prelim credit computation: given the contract's proportional credit formula we preliminarily estimate a 0.53% service credit for the billing period. Because some of the effect coincided with a model promotion initiated by Redwood (not scheduled by the customer), we propose Redwood accepts 70% of the credit and Novacart is offered the remaining 30% as a gesture to cover any residual client retries.

Action items:
1) If Novacart agrees in principle, we'll draft a formal credit note and route to finance (cc: billing).
2) We will schedule a joint technical postmortem (30–45min) next week to go over mitigation (safer promotion sequencing, autoscaler prechecks).
3) We will include a telemetry bundle for your internal audit (link in related links).

Please confirm acceptance of the proposed split or propose an alternate ratio by EOD Monday.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of SLA Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: novacart-trace-excerpt.txt, prelim-credit-proposal.xlsx
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novacart.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 20:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Production availability gap during peak — request for SLO adjudication

Kimberly / Sean —

Appreciate the quick investigation and the detailed bundle. Novacart accepts the proposed 70/30 split provisionally; procurement will process the credit note once we receive the formal document and the telemetry bundle. We do want the postmortem to include a commitment on changes to the promotion process and an ETA for the autoscaler precheck fix.

Two logistical asks:
- please send the formal credit note (matching your prelim calc) to procurement@novacart.com
- include a calendar invite for the postmortem (30–45min) next Wed/Thu preferred

Thanks,
Marta

Attachments: none
